info.name: Amazon S3 Control Access Control Bucket Configuration API

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Returns the versioning state of a bucket. To retrieve the versioning state of a bucket, you must be the bucket owner. This implementation also returns the MFA Delete status of a bucket.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Sets the versioning state of an existing bucket. To set the versioning state, you must be the bucket owner. You can set the versioning state to Enabled or Suspended.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Returns the default encryption configuration for an Amazon S3 bucket. By default, all buckets have a default encryption configuration that uses server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3).

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: This action uses the encryption subresource to configure default encryption and Amazon S3 Bucket Keys for an existing bucket.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: This implementation of the DELETE action resets the default encryption for the bucket as server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3).

info.name: Amazon S3 Get Bucket Lifecycle Configuration

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Returns the lifecycle configuration information set on the bucket. It returns the lifecycle configuration for the specified bucket or an error if the lifecycle configuration does not exist.

info.name: Amazon S3 Put Bucket Lifecycle Configuration

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Creates a new lifecycle configuration for the bucket or replaces an existing lifecycle configuration. Lifecycle configuration manages objects so that they are stored cost effectively throughout their lifecycle.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Deletes the lifecycle configuration from the specified bucket. Amazon S3 removes all the lifecycle configuration rules in the lifecycle subresource associated with the bucket.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Returns the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration information set for the bucket. To use this operation, you must have permission to perform the s3:GetBucketCORS action.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Sets the CORS configuration for your bucket. If the configuration exists, Amazon S3 replaces it. To use this operation, you must be allowed to perform the s3:PutBucketCORS action.

params.name: Bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket. Bucket names must be between 3 and 63 characters long, consist only of lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and periods, and must begin and end with a letter or number.

items.docs: Deletes the CORS configuration information set for the bucket.
